description: This Scala source file defines a web UI page for Spark Connect Server statistics, including classes for rendering server stats, session stats, and SQL execution stats in a paginated table format within the Spark UI.

classes.name: SparkConnectServerPage
classes.description: A web UI page displaying Spark Connect server statistics, sessions, and SQL request info.

classes.name: SqlStatsPagedTable
classes.description: A paginated table for displaying SQL execution statistics within the Spark UI.

classes.name: SessionStatsPagedTable
classes.description: A paginated table for displaying session statistics within the Spark UI.

classes.name: SqlStatsTableRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row in the SQL statistics table.

classes.name: SqlStatsTableDataSource
classes.description: Data source for paginated SQL stats table, converting ExecutionInfo to table rows and handling sorting.

classes.name: SessionStatsTableDataSource
classes.description: Data source for paginated session stats table, handling sorting of SessionInfo.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire Spark Connect server statistics page.

methods.name: generateBasicStats
methods.description: Generates basic server start time and uptime statistics.

methods.name: generateSQLStatsTable
methods.description: Generates the SQL request statistics table or message if none.

methods.name: generateSessionStatsTable
methods.description: Generates the session statistics table or message if none.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Creates the HTML table for SQL or session stats, paginated.

methods.name: row
methods.description: Generates a table row for a SQL or session statistic entry.

methods.name: ordering
methods.description: Defines sorting order for table data based on column and direction.
